caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular design with a symmetrical, embroidered look, rendered mainly in shades of red, blue, and black on a beige background. The left side features a vertical border composed of repeating diamond shapes and a multicolor band with alternating red, white, and blue segments. In the upper left corner, there are red flowers and leaves with curving stems, and below them is a stylized blue animal, possibly a dog or lion, surrounded by blue plants. In the lower left quadrant, there is a block of text written in uppercase red and blue letters that reads "EMANUEL ETTINGER ARONSBURG." At the bottom, aligned with the diamond border, the year "1840" is inscribed within diamond shapes in blue. The upper right side contains a stylized arrangement of large red flowers resembling roses or peonies, with blue and black leaves and small blue flowers scattered around. Below this, two red birds face each other, perched on a symmetrical blue and black scrollwork design interspersed with floral and foliate patterns. The composition is framed by a thin red border, and the artist's name, "WM. HOFMANN," appears in small writing at the bottom right corner.
title: Coverlet
